## Why cookieless analytics matters

Founders waste hours in bloated dashboards that track everything but answer nothing. Acme shows the five numbers that matter in one weekly email, without cookies, so there is no cookie banner to add.

## Getting started

Setup takes two minutes with one script tag. Acme is GDPR compliant and hosted in the EU, and Starter is $9 per month for up to 100k pageviews.

## Try it

Start with the free 14-day trial; no credit card required.
